pages.text: Mass is the reactor's fuel. $(thing)Every block counts as 1 mass$(), whatever it is.$(br2)Insert blocks by hand, with hoppers, or with pipes.

Each stabilizer needs at least $(num)10,000$() mass before ignition. There is $(thing)no maximum$().$(br2)More mass runs longer, but makes a bigger crater if it all goes wrong.$(br2)A comparator shows how close a port is to the ignition minimum.
pages.title: How much?
